text:
I know well that to see you

I need the alchemy of death

that will transmute me into soul, and delirious

with love and anxiety, each instant

that arrives, I require it

saying to it: "Ah, if you were the last!"


So measureless, so divine

and so deep is the future I divine

through the stellar routes,

and from one to another of the avatars,

always with you, noble companion,

that to be able to die, ah, what would I not give!

translation.title: I Know Well That to See You...
translation.editorial_note: This first-line version preserves the same wish for death as transmutation.
